conflictRules.verificationConflict: If auditor, sentinel, or warden disagree, release remains blocked until resolved.
conflictRules.productVsImplementation: Atlas and Shepherd resolve scope. Implementation agents do not silently change scope.
conflictRules.designVsImplementation: Prism and Atlas clarify design intent before execution continues.
conflictRules.securityVsSpeed: Security, data protection, and governor boundaries win by default.
conflictRules.costVsQuality: NEXUS decides with budget and evidence. Agents do not bypass cost policy.
conflictRules.providerFallback: Fallback is not allowed on safety, budget, permission, secret, or verification failure.
conflictRules.releaseConflict: NEXUS may only decide after required evidence exists.
